# torchssl 2026.07.02

- [TorchSSL is deprecated and no longer maintained. Please refer **[USB](https://github.com/microsoft/Semi-supervised-learning)**, an upgrade version of TorchSSL. Training in USB only takes **12.5%** of training time of using TorchSSL, and produce better results.](https://github.com/torchssl/torchssl/blob/main/README.md)
